paite: Mi akinak ua, vaihawmna mun a ahoh uleh, vaihawmte'n ana gensak ding ua, midiktat siam atangsak ding ua, migilou moh atangsak ding uhi.
heading: Migilou Gawtna Dan
english: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, migilou zep tuak mah ahihleh, vaihawmmi in alumsak dia, ama ah azep ding ahi. Agitlouh dungzui a zep ding zah bikhiah ding ahi.
english: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

paite: Sawmli vei tan zep theih ahi dia, huai val zaw hilou in. Hiai sang a val azepleh na unaupa uh na zahlaksak lo kha ding uh.
english: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

paite: Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk na gak ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.

paite: Unaute tengkhawm uhenla, tapa nei lou in alak ua khat si taleh, asipa zi in polam a midang akitenpih ding ahi kei. Apasal unaupa in aluah dia, zi in anei dia, apasal unau mohpuakna tung ah ahih ding ahi.
heading: Unaupa Sih Tung A Mohpuakna
english: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, atachil suansak in Israel lak a, amin amanlouhna ding in a-unau sipa min apu ding ahi.
english: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

paite: Ama'n a-unaupa zi kitenpih a-ut keileh, kulh kongpi a upate kiang ah a-unaupa zi ahohtou dia, "Ka pasal unaupa'n Israel lak a a-unaupa min omsak zel a-ut kei a, ka pasal unaupa hih ding ka tung ah ahih nuam kei," ava chi ding hi.
english: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

paite: Huchi in akho upate un amah asam ding ua, ahoupih ding ua ama'n, "Ka kitenpih nuam kei," chi a apanleh;
english: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”

paite: a-unaupa zi akiang ah upate ma ah ahong dia, upate ma ava naihtou dia, akhedap asuahsak dia, amai ah achil ase ding hi. "A-unaupa inkuan khotuah nuamloupa tung ah hichibang a hih hi ngeingei hen," achi ding hi.
english: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

paite: Huchi in inkuan khedap suahsakpa, chi in Israelte lak ah amin putsak ahi ding hi.
english: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

paite: Mikilai uhenla, akhat penpa zi in akilaihpihpa a pan apasal honkhe ding in azahmoh kaihsak taleh;
heading: Dan Dangte
english: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,

paite: akhut na tansak ding uh ahi. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei.
english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.

paite: Na ip sung uah bukna suang chi tuamtuam, agik leh azang na nei ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.

paite: Na inn uah tehna chi tuamtuam, alian leh aneu na kem ding uh ahi kei,
english: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

paite: Bukna diktak leh hoihtak na nei ding uh ahi. Tehna diktak leh hoihtak na nei ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon gam piak ah na damsawt ding uhi.
english: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: Huchibang hihmi, diktat loutak a hih tengteng TOUPA na Pathian un akih hi.
english: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtna lampi ua Amalekte'n hon na bawldan uh:
heading: Amalekte That Dia Thupiak
english: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

paite: Pathian leng lau lou a, na bah lai uh leh na nguai lai ua lampi a hon kituahpih a, na lak ua ananungpente, na nunglam ua hatloute, na bah lai leh na gim lai ua hon na sualdante uh theigige un.
english: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.

paite: Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia gam ahon piak chiang in, na kim ua na melma tengteng ua pan TOUPA na Pathian un galmuanna ahon piak chiang in van nuai a Amalekte theihgigena na hihmang sipsip ding uhi. Na mangngilh ding uh ahi kei.
english: Therefore it shall be, when Yahweh your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.
